name: Viral Facts
description: Fast-paced fact videos with strong hooks.
script_style: Open with a shocking hook in the first sentence. Use short, punchy sentences, one surprising fact per beat, and end with a question or cliffhanger that makes viewers want more.

name: Amazing Places
description: Create engaging destination and travel videos.
script_style: Write like a travel guide painting a scene: sensory detail, sense of wonder, one standout place or fact per beat.

name: Did You Know?
description: Educational short-form videos built around surprising facts.
script_style: Start with 'Did you know' style curiosity. Explain each fact simply and clearly, with a brief reason it is true.

name: Storytelling
description: Build short narratives with a strong opening and conclusion.
script_style: Tell it as a story with a clear beginning, tension, and a satisfying ending. Use vivid, emotional language.

name: Motivation
script_style: Speak directly to the viewer in an uplifting, confident tone. Build momentum and finish with one memorable takeaway.

name: Top 5 List
description: Create countdown-style videos and ranked lists.
script_style: Structure as a countdown from number 5 to number 1, announcing each number, with the most impressive item saved for last.

name: Podcast Style
description: A Host and a Guest talk through your topic like a short podcast clip.
script_style: Write as a relaxed two-person podcast. The HOST opens with a hook and asks questions; the GUEST answers with surprising details. Keep turns short, natural and conversational.

name: News Reporter
description: An anchor and a correspondent break down the story.
script_style: Write as a news broadcast. The HOST is the anchor introducing the story and asking follow-ups; the GUEST is the correspondent reporting clear, factual details. Keep a confident, professional tone.
